svg.text: Cards, runes and what they mean
Shape, motion and sound carry every meaning too; nothing depends on colour alone
a made-up word looks exactly like a real one
The ribbon, the star, runes and marks
the star stays dim until every gap holds a card
prefix runes snap to a card's front, suffix runes to its back (un + lock: the lock opens)
words fly as ink and dive into the page; a
a pencil patch floods with watercolour
a number not filled: empty glowing outlines
a plain verb with one doer: ink copies join in
a made-up word: the Jumble comes
when: an old photo (it happened), now, a
gold: being said, lit · teal: ready · green:
a golden word in the Spellbook: read by
